scope: Every .sv/.svh/.v/.vh member in the exact final ZIP; comments, strings and legal escaped identifiers are excluded lexically.
required_conjunction: exact final ZIP reserved_identifier_violations=[] after fresh archive read
existing focused or production-compatible frontend pass on exact changed/required package-local HDL
release_sequence: shared lexical gate current-disk sync and regression pass
GAP, native Conv and QAdd may build their fresh FSDB successors in parallel
each exact final ZIP must pass this gate and the current first-fresh aggregate before pending publication
claim_boundary: This cheap lexical guard prevents a known compile-before-simulation escape; it does not replace production VCS or the broader package-local HDL gate.
